name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_ prefix + dialog domain (consumed by the dialog VM) + _param suffix (caller->dialog parameter-passing slot). No Ghidra address residue. Part of an established sibling family at adjacent addresses (data_fd2_dialog_last_action_sprite_id_param @0x53AD9, data_fd2_dialog_drop_swap_text_id_param @0x53ADD); renaming would break family consistency. 'value' correctly reflects the scalar data type. The role is uniform across all 20 xref sites: a numeric value staged for the dialog VM to format/render (and, for prices/gold, also read for arithmetic).
purpose: Transient 32-bit staging slot: a numeric value a caller writes immediately before invoking fd2_display_dialog_scene so the dialog VM can render it as a decimal number (opcode -6 LITERAL NUMBER, via sprintf %d); for prices/gold it is also read back directly for arithmetic.
logic_summary: Single shared 32-bit global, written-before-read on every path (binary zero-inits it). Writers across subsystems set it to: stat-gain delta (fd2_roll_stat_gain_and_show_message, then *(int16*)stat_ptr += value), XP credit (fd2_process_xp_and_level_up_for_char), poison damage = wHP_max/10 (fd2_tick_status_effects_and_show_messages), gold drop amount (fd2_process_battle_drop_entries type 1, then party_total_gold += value), shop item price = *(u16*)(item_entry+0x13) (fd2_run_buy_item_menu / fd2_run_sell_item_menu, used for signed affordability test vs party_total_gold and for fd2_animate_money_decrement), promote cost (fd2_execute_class_promotion_with_dialog), revive cost (fd2_run_revive_menu_main), save-slot index (fd2_render_save_slot_grid), and tile-event values (fd2_handle_tile_event_interaction). Reader fd2_display_dialog_scene, on opcode 0xFFFA (-6), does sprintf(buf,"%d",value) then blits each digit glyph.
element_semantics: Scalar 32-bit value. Interpreted by the writer's context: stat-gain delta / XP / poison HP loss / gold amount / item price / promote cost / revive cost / save-slot index. The dialog VM treats it as a signed decimal for %d rendering; price/gold paths treat it as a signed int for comparison and arithmetic.
notes: src comment block (btl_turn.c lines 1021-1034) was already accurate, precise, and ASCII-clean (covers gold/poison/XP/stat-gain/price/promote/save-slot uses, the -6 LITERAL-NUMBER sprintf mechanism, the direct gold/price arithmetic reads, multi-writer/home-owner structure, and zero-init rationale); kept unchanged. Ghidra data plate at 0x53AE1 was empty (null) so a concise plate was created via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) reflecting the src conclusion. 20 xref sites examined/consistent. No source statements/types/control-flow touched. No logic issues found.
